# PersianToolbox (جعبه ابزار فارسی)
> PersianToolbox provides privacy-first online tools for Persian-speaking users, with free tools and paid export options. Files and text entered into the local-first document, image, PDF and writing tools are processed in the browser. Account, payment and operational services use server endpoints; see https://persiantoolbox.ir/privacy for the current privacy policy.

## Overview
PersianToolbox (https://persiantoolbox.ir) is a collection of 100+ browser-based utilities covering PDF, image, date, text, finance, contract, business, career, writing, and SEO needs. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, it targets Persian-speaking professionals and individuals across Iran and the diaspora.

## Key Pages
- `/` — Homepage with tool overview, categories, and featured tools
- `/tools` - Directory of tools across all categories
- `/pdf-tools` — PDF merge, split, compress, watermark, encrypt
- `/image-tools` — Image resize, crop, compress, convert, watermark, background removal
- `/tools/persian-ocr` — Extract Persian and English text from images in the browser; image input only
- `/date-tools` — Jalali/Shamsi date converter, days between dates
- `/text-tools` — Text diff, word count, case converter, slug generator
- `/validation-tools` — National ID validator, bank card validator, phone/email validators
- `/contract-tools` — Legal contract builder (rent, sale, construction, salon, vehicle)
- `/business-tools` — Invoice, proforma invoice, receipt generator
- `/career-tools` — Resume builder, experience certificate, employment contract
- `/writing-tools` — Persian writing studio (ZWNJ, normalization, punctuation, spacing)
- `/seo-tools` — Meta tag generator, robots.txt builder, structured data tools
- `/blog` - Persian articles and guides on web tools, career and finance
- `/about` — About PersianToolbox and the team
- `/contact` — Contact form
- `/pricing` — Subscription plans and pay-per-export packs
- `/admin` — Admin dashboard (restricted)

## Tool Categories
1. **PDF Tools** — Merge, split, compress, watermark, encrypt, decrypt, rotate, reorder pages
2. **Image Tools** — Resize, crop, compress, convert (PNG/JPG/WebP), watermark, background removal
3. **Date Tools** — Shamsi/Gregorian converter, day calculator, age calculator
4. **Text Tools** — Diff checker, word/character counter, case converter, slug generator, text cleaner
5. **Finance Tools** — Loan calculator, salary calculator, unit converter, currency converter
6. **Validation Tools** — National ID (Iran), bank card, phone number, email, IP address, URL validators
7. **Contract Tools** — Legal document builder for rent, sale, construction, beauty salon, vehicle contracts
8. **Business Tools** — فاکتور (invoice), پیش‌فاکتور (proforma), رسید (receipt) — PDF/HTML export
9. **Career Tools** — رزومه (resume builder), certificate, employment contract — Persian RTL + English LTR
10. **Writing Tools** — Persian text normalization, ZWNJ correction, punctuation, spacing, text statistics
11. **SEO Tools** — Meta tag generator, robots.txt generator, structured data (JSON-LD) builder

## Flagship Products
- **فاکتورساز و رسیدساز** (`/business-tools/document-studio`) — Invoice/receipt generator with free preview and premium export
- **رزومه‌ساز حرفه‌ای** (`/career-tools/resume-builder`) — Persian RTL resume builder with live preview
- **ویرایشگر فارسی** (`/writing-tools/persian-writing-studio`) — Persian text editor for ZWNJ, normalization, punctuation

## High-intent tools and answer boundaries
- **اختلاف دو تاریخ** (`/date-tools/date-difference`) — Calculates the number of days between two dates; supports Persian/Jalali and Gregorian input. It is a date calculation, not a legal or official deadline determination.
- **محاسبه سن** (`/date-tools/age-calculator`) — Calculates exact age from a birth date and reference date; the result is informational and processed locally in the browser.
- **تبدیل تاریخ به روز هفته** (`/date-tools/weekday-finder`) — Finds the weekday for a Persian/Jalali or Gregorian date.
- **اعتبارسنجی کد ملی** (`/validation-tools/national-id`) — Checks the structure and checksum of a ۱۰رقمی Iranian national-ID value; it does not verify identity or query government records.
- **اعتبارسنجی کد پستی** (`/validation-tools/postal-code`) — Checks the ten-digit postal-code format; it does not perform an official address lookup.
- **گواهی سابقه کار** (`/career-tools/work-certificate`) — Creates an editable Persian work-history certificate draft for PDF/Word export; the document is not an official certificate until issued and signed by the employer.
- **شماره‌گذاری صفحات PDF** (`/pdf-tools/edit/add-page-numbers`) — Adds page numbers to a PDF in the browser and exports the result.
- **استخراج صفحات PDF** (`/pdf-tools/extract/extract-pages`) — جدا کردن صفحات موردنظر از PDF و ساخت فایل جدید در مرورگر؛ خروجی برای دانلود آماده می‌شود.
- **فاکتور و رسیدساز** (`/tools/invoice-generator`, `/business-tools/document-studio`) — Creates invoice, proforma and receipt drafts for print/PDF/HTML export; outputs are business-document drafts, not tax authority verification.

## Pricing
- Free tools and previews are available; paid exports and subscriptions have plan-specific limits.
- Current prices, currency, export credits and limits: https://persiantoolbox.ir/pricing
- Pricing is managed dynamically. Use the current pricing page rather than treating this file as a price quote.

## API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` — Server health check (returns JSON status)
- `GET /api/version` — Application version info
- Local-first tool content is processed in the browser; account, payment and operational APIs are server-side services.

## Content
- Persian articles covering web tools, career advice and finance guides; see `/blog` for current published content.
- All content in Persian (Farsi) with RTL layout
- RSS feed available at `/feed.xml`

## Technical Details
- Local-first tools process document contents, images and text in the browser; see `/privacy` for service-specific data handling.
- Current source license: https://github.com/alirezasafaei-dev/persiantoolbox/blob/main/LICENSE
- Version-specific licensing policy: https://github.com/alirezasafaei-dev/persiantoolbox/blob/main/docs/licensing/dual-license-policy.md
- Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support
- Persian RTL layout with dark mode support
- Vazirmatn font family
